page: Microsoft Azure E64_v3 is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the Ev3 family, powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8272CL processor running at 2.6 GHz. The configuration provides 64 virtual CPUs mapped to 32 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. Cache resources include 32 KB L1d, 1.0 MB L2, and 35 MB L3 cache. It features 432.0 GB of system memory, yielding 6.75 GB per core. Local storage is bundled with a 1638 GB SSD, and there are no GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses included.

Benchmark data indicates a contrast between single-core and multi-core performance. Single-core metrics, such as stress-ng single-core CPU, Geekbench single-core, and single-threaded gzip compression, fall into the bottom 25% tier. Conversely, multi-core performance, including stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, registers in the middle 50% tier. Memory bandwidth for large, potentially uncached blocks (256MB) is strong, placing in the top 25% for both read and write operations, whereas small-block cached read bandwidth remains average. Large-model LLM inference text generation is poor, scoring in the bottom 10% for small and medium models.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the E64_v3 offers high memory density and bundled local SSD storage, making it suitable for memory-bound workloads that do not require high single-threaded CPU performance. The instance is suited for database operations, static web serving, and multi-threaded data processing tasks, supported by its average Passmark database and Redis SET performance. However, it is less suitable for single-threaded applications or intensive LLM text generation due to its weaker single-core and text processing benchmark results.
description: Microsoft Azure E64_v3 is an x86_64 memory-optimized server instance from the Ev3 family, featuring 64 vCPUs across 32 physical Intel Xeon 8272CL cores at 2.6 GHz. It is equipped with 432.0 GB of RAM and a bundled 1638 GB local SSD, with no GPU acceleration. Benchmarks show weak single-core CPU and single-threaded compression performance, placing in the bottom 25%. However, multi-core CPU execution, software compilation, and database operations perform at an average level. Notably, large-block uncached memory read and write bandwidth are strong, ranking in the top 25%. This profile makes the E64_v3 qualitatively cost-efficient for memory-intensive, multi-threaded workloads such as database hosting, Redis deployments, and static web serving, while representing a tradeoff for workloads dependent on high single-threaded speed or LLM text generation.
og_description: Microsoft Azure E64_v3 is an x86_64 server with 64 vCPUs, 432 GB RAM, and a 1638 GB local SSD. It delivers strong large-block memory bandwidth alongside average multi-core performance for database and web workloads.

tagline: An x86_64 server combining high memory capacity and bundled SSD storage with strong large-block memory bandwidth for multi-threaded workloads.

Bundled 1638 GB local SSD storage for fast data access.
